description.text: We have three grades of Long-term Chinese Courses for foreign students with different Chinese levels: Beginners, Intermediate and Advanced courses. Each grade has several classes in order to let every student have a suitable class to learn his/her Chinese easily. Study duration is above 6 months/one semester. Opening time: Every September.Curriculums of Long-term Chinese Courses Course Required Courses Total hours per week Selective Courses HSK Courses Beginners Class Intensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Extensive Reading, Listening 20 Chinese Handwriting, Calligraphy, Wushu (Gongfu), Tai chi (shadow boxing), Audio-video, Chinese Painting, Chinese Folk Music, Business in China, Chinese History, Chinese Customs, Chinese Culture, Chinese Literature, Chinese Film, Chinese Philosophy, etc. HSK, Intermediate Level and Advanced Level Intermediate Class Intensive Reading, Oral Chinese, Extensive Reading, Listening 20 Senior Class Intensive Reading, Listening (Including News Listening), Extensive Reading (Including Newspaper Reading), Oral Chinese, Chinese Writing 20 Note: If you could get tourist visa to China and then university could help you transfer your visa, then you could apply this program. But maybe you apply this program and the university could transfer the visa type, then you maybe refused by the university.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese course at Qingdao University of Science and Technology is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 972 USD/per semester ￥ 7000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graducation Certificate of High schoolGraduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: Academic record equivalent to a Chinese Junior High School Graduate.
